basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old software engineering student from Austin, Texas, currently diving into the world of Python. I spend most of my online hours in the late evenings after classes, exploring new coding techniques and working on small projects. I'm single and enjoy hiking and watching sci-fi movies during the weekends. My main goal is to build a solid foundation in programming languages and eventually work in AI development.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I started learning Python about six months ago through online courses and tutorials. My background is primarily in computer science, but I'm self-teaching Python to complement my university studies and enhance my coding skills.
